$comment: What a copy of this mini app is made of. Read by the mini-app-authoring plugin (plugins/mini-app-authoring: the scaffold, the residue check and the skills) and by staging (scripts/stage-mini-app-kit.mjs ships the template minus authoringOnly). The plumbing lives in the SDK (createMiniApp, defineCollection, useCollection, screenUi), so a copy is entries and domain only. Placeholders: {name} lower-kebab, {snake} lower_snake, {displayName}.
summary: Daily Log reference mini app (entries the agent logs from what the person says or shows, a daily goal from Settings, a screen with today's total, a 7-day chart and a quick-add form)

patterns.use: the data the agent and the screen share: a collection with its schema, how an item is made and what search reads
the backend's whole wiring: collections, extra routes and tools
agent tools that write, read and search, each answering with where things stand
settings the person changes (mini-app.json config) and an extra route
logic both sides share: the summary the screen shows and the agent is told
the screen: a collection, a settings route, the agent context, a problem line
a hero number in a progress ring, with bars per category
a chart of the last days
a list with remove, and an empty state that points to the chat
a form that adds through the collection and clears once stored
the tab, its launcher and what the agent is told while it is open
tests: the agent's tools and the screen's routes on one store
